issue.title: Update tui_screenshot memory for runtime resvg dependency
issue.description: While implementing the approved screenshot_renderer_runtime_dependency plan, the reference memory sase/memory/tui_screenshot.md still said missing screenshot rasterization support means installing the visual extra. This is now stale because resvg_py is promoted to an unconditional runtime dependency and the renderer diagnostic now points to stale/incomplete installs.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: In Troubleshooting, replace the stale 'Missing visual extra' guidance with the new runtime contract: resvg_py is an unconditional dependency for normal installs; a missing import means the installed SASE environment is incomplete or stale, so users should run sase update or reinstall/upgrade the Python environment that owns the sase entry point. Keep the single canonical renderer guidance.
